target.statement: Accuracy of Random Forest with entropy-based features on CIC-IDS2017 (0.9248 ± 0.0003), compared to baseline 0.9047 ± 0.0005

compute.basis: CIC-IDS2017 (~1.7 GB CSV, 2.8M rows) is public; Random Forest on CPU is feasible, but the entropy feature construction (sliding-window joint entropy over multiple features) and 15-fold CV must be re-implemented from a vague description, and the paper reports ~77 min per run, so a clean re-run plus implementation is a few hours.

blockers: No code released; entropy feature (window size w, feature pairs, binning) underspecified
15-fold CV over 2.8M rows with sliding-window joint entropy is slow on CPU (~4600 s reported per run)
Exact reproduction of reported means/std depends on unspecified preprocessing and binning choices
title: On the Impact of Entropy-based Features
